tier_definitions.R: Real-Exact: lay thang tu nguon that, khong bien doi
tier_definitions.RD: Real-Derived: tinh tu truong that bang cong thuc xac dinh
tier_definitions.RS: Real-Statistically-Parameterized: sinh synthetic tham so hoa tu phan phoi/tai lieu that
tier_definitions.S: Scenario-Construct: dung co chu dich cho kich ban, khong co tuong ung that

timestamp.note: Synthetic 15-min interval x 96 sample/ngay x 15 ngay x 60 VIN pilot.

speed_kmh.note: State-machine driven: speed>0 chi trong DRIVING_PASSENGER/DEADHEAD, deadhead thap hon trip co khach.

motor_rpm.note: EV single-speed gear ratio VF8 ~ 9.7: RPM = speed * 73.2 + noise.

battery_soc.note: Physical: SOC giam khi DRIVING*, tang khi CHARGING, stable khi IDLE. Bounds: 92-98% (sau overnight) -> 28-42% (cuoi operating hours).

battery_voltage.note: Correlated nghich voi SOC, noise theo VED distribution.

battery_current.note: Discharge (+) khi DRIVING, charge (-) khi CHARGING, near 0 khi IDLE.

latitude.note: Synthetic trong bbox HN, dao dong khi xe chay.

accel_z.note: Dao dong +/-0.3 khi xe chay, = 0 khi xe dung.

vehicle_vin.note: FULL FLEET telemetry-capable: 60 pilot x 15 days x 96 samples/day.

ved_reference_veh_id.note: VED VehId lam per-vehicle distribution reference (cycle 20 -> 60).

state_at_sample.note: State machine lookup tai timestamp: DRIVING_PASSENGER / DEADHEAD / IDLE / CHARGING. Disjoint guarantee vi 4 states mutually exclusive theo thoi gian.

duration_mins.note: Tier R: lay tu ACN duration that.

station_temp_c.note: Normal(loc=45, scale=10), clip [20, 65] C. Reference: IEC 61851-23.

cost_vnd.note: kwh_consumed (Tier R) x EVN tariff (3,100 VND/kWh).

status.note: Baseline mac dinh; fault injection o Layer 3.

soft_overlap_flag.note: 2026-08-08 v4: state machine guarantees disjoint by construction. Cot giu de backward-compat, nhung luon False (khong con overlap case).

trip_id.note: ID ky thuat sinh moi theo format XANH_TRIP_XXXX.

pickup_datetime.note: Schedule anchor theo build_per_vin_day_schedule, operating hours 6h-22h.

currency_unverified.note: Cot flag: False = da xac minh VND.

pickup_latitude.note: Synthetic trong bbox Ha Noi (fact_rides khong co lat/lon so).

sentence.note: Text tieng Viet that nhung LECH DOMAIN (feedback sinh vien, khong phai app goi xe/tram sac) — chi dung de kiem dinh module chuan hoa/NLP chung, khong dung lam feedback content chinh

topic.note: Topic khong khop enum VinGroup, chi dung noi bo
